scope: Source-reviewed existing Rust build-script helpers emitting cfg/constants/generated text or querying compiler versions only. No helper is rebuilt. Proc_macro2 and thiserror retain skip because they run rustc metadata compilation probes.

review_findings.safe: Reviewed active paths emit Cargo cfg values, generated Rust private/version constants, or query rustc -vV/--version. ICU4X data helpers only inspect explicit data environment and print cfg. std/libm/serde_json_lenient helpers only compute cfg from the clean Cargo-like target environment. libc can also query emcc -dumpversion; no source compilation command is present.
review_findings.compiler_builtins: A C compilation branch exists behind #[cfg(feature="c")], but the selected compiled helper GN rustflags do not enable c and its dependencies include no cc crate. The exact selected features/dependencies are retained in the reviewed plan; the active helper only emits cfg.
review_findings.skipped: proc_macro2 and thiserror compile probe crates with rustc --crate-type=lib --emit=dep-info,metadata, producing new .rmeta metadata. They remain skipped because compilation is reserved for the user.
review_findings.execution_boundary: Only existing helper binaries were used. The generic generator runner still skips all arbitrary Cargo build scripts; this is a separate source/hash-specific review.
